name: 57106 · Sioux Falls, SD
findings: ZIP 57106 (Sioux Falls) has 104 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (59%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 57106 (Sioux Falls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 57106 (Sioux Falls) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
